notes.title: Uurnog Uurnlimited won Excellence in Audio at the IGFs!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30494326/818c9204e479f31548c24b9bd30cc64b09edcf47.png[/img]In case you missed the news, Uurnog Uurnlimited won Excellence in Audio at the IGFs! The Independent Games Festival are a huge honor for independent developers like Nifflas, the creator of Uurnog. 

The Raw Fury team accepted the award on behalf of Nicklas, which you can watch here: https://twitter.com/rawfury/status/976638849383202816

Here's the full list of winners: http://www.igf.com/article/night-woods-baba-you-win-big-2018-igf-awards

Congrats again, Nifflas!

notes.title: Night In The Woods wins IGF Grand Prize
notes.notes: Rad trash mammal simulator Night In The Woods scooped this year’s Grand Prize during the 2018 Independent Games Festival Awards at the Game Developers Conference last night, also lifting the award for Excellence In Narrative. Baba Is You, an upcoming puzzle game about shifting words to change how parts of the levels and game work, also picked up two awards. Looking across all the winners, ah yes, there certainly are good video games going around. (more…)

notes.title: Uurnog Uurnlimited nominated for TWO IGF awards!
notes.notes:
What is the IGF? It's the Independent Games Festival and it's basically a big deal in the indie world. Like the Oscars, but for indie games. 

And we're floored to see that Uurnog Uurnlimited was nominated for Excellence in Audio AND Excellence in Design: 

http://www.igf.com/article/2018-independent-games-festival-announces-main-competition-finalists

We just wanted to share the good news and we're looking forward to the awards taking place next month during the Game Developers Conference.

notes.title: 80/100 review from PC Gamer!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30494326/818c9204e479f31548c24b9bd30cc64b09edcf47.png[/img]

If you're curious about Uurnog Uurnlimited and want to know more than check no further than the PC Gamer review. 

"By designing solutions with the save room in mind, Uurnog achieves so much more than the usual insert-puzzle-here malarky. Buttons, lasers and time clones can't compete with a customizable toolkit and near-limitless interdimensional storage. It's totally hands-off but it successfully teaches you to think differently, which is the mark of any good puzzle game."

Full review here: http://www.pcgamer.com/uurnog-uurnlimited-review/

notes.title: Uurnog Uurnlimited adds co-op to Nifflas s platformer
notes.notes: Earlier this year, Knytt creator Nifflas and chums released Uurnog, a puzzle-platformer about stealing animals to use them as power-ups, which also rocked neat-o algorithmic dynamic music. It was one of those there ‘Humble Originals’, smaller games commissioned by Humble for their subscription service and store. Now the devs are revisiting and expanding Uurnog, adding features like cooperative play and a level editor, for a new release as Uurnog Uurnlimited [official site]. Have a peek: (more…)

notes.title: Introducing Uurnog Uurnlimited – Uurndoubtedly the Most Uurnpredictible Platformer in the Uurniverse
notes.notes:
[b]Next project from Raw Fury and developer Nifflas coming to Switch and Steam this fall![/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30494326/236196f122bcf5ed1d9355865000179b3745e1c2.jpg[/img]

Hello world, meet [b]Uurnog Uurnlimited[/b]—the next game to be published by Raw Fury and developed by the incredibly talented Nifflas! It is, with absolute certainty, the quirkiest game we have signed to date (and that says a lot considering we published [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/437570/GoNNER/]GoNNER[/url] <3) and the uurnbelievable amount of puns you can make out of its name was at least 20% of the reason we told ourselves WE NEED TO BE A PART OF THIS NIFFLAS PLEASE PLEASE PLEASE.

[h1][b]Announce Trailer:[/b][/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TrBjWPEQ0js
[h1]This game has everything:[/h1]
• Animal stealing… err, collecting
• Algorithmic music that adapts the melody and more to gameplay
• Local co-op where your friend plays as an adorable dog on a leash
• Just want to emphasize how cute this dog is by adding another line about it
• Really (still talking about the dog)
• Boss fights, multiple endings, a Save Room that is not what you think, and more!
• A Steamworks level editor (post-launch) 

[b]Uurnlimited???[/b]
You may have seen Uurnog before, the original version was released as a Humble exclusive. This is the [b]Uurnlimited[/b] version, which is an extended edition with a bunch of new features (co-op, additional endings, boss fights, and level editor) and will mark the first time the world of Uurnog will be available to Switch and Steam users!

[b]Uurnog Uurnlimited[/b] will be available later this year! The wait won’t be too uurnbearable, promise.
 
[h1]For more info on [b]Uurnog Uurnlimited[/b]:[/h1]
Official site: uurnog.com
Steam group: http://steamcommunity.com/groups/rawfurygames
Join us on Discord: discord.gg/rawfury
